quarterly_data.quarter: NVIDIA press release: NVIDIA Expands AI Infrastructure Capacity in Partnership (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Australia build-out partners named: NVIDIA Cloud Partners and AI infrastructure partners Firmus, Sharon AI, IREN, Megaport, ResetData, CDC, NEXTDC and AirTrunk will expand land, power and shell capacity for NVIDIA DSX AI factories - up to a 2-gigawatt buildout by 2027 - with the providers operating the AI factories and NVIDIA delivering the DSX platform, accelerated computing, networking and software. Sharon AI is deploying up to 68,000 NVIDIA GPUs connected with Quantum InfiniBand and Spectrum-X Ethernet; IREN is applying the DSX reference architecture to its 800-megawatt Bundey campus in South Australia; Firmus is expanding Project Southgate.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 2-gigawatt buildout by 2027; up to 68,000 NVIDIA GPUs (Sharon AI); 800-megawatt Bundey campus (IREN)
